kpi_results.kpi: CSV export covers 100% of JSON export categories
kpi_results.actual: Met by #1365: exportCsvFiles writes one CSV per exported category plus processing-information.csv and withheld.csv, from the same download as the JSON (apps/web/src/lib/dsar/export-csv.ts and its tests). The Art 20(2) page of this pull request reuses the same saveExportCsv, so a transferred file has the same CSV.

Proven against a real database (tests/integration/dsar-transfer.test.ts): the second download is NOT_FOUND, five simultaneous downloads give exactly one export, the link works one millisecond before its stored expiry and not at it, and a mutation that drops the usedAt condition from the claim is caught by the concurrency test. this pull request.

Measured with vitest coverage on the new files: domain dsar-transfer.ts 100% statements and branches; DsarTransferService.ts 96.2% statements, 97.1% branches; PrismaDsarTransferRepository.ts 100% statements, 95.5% branches; privacy-admin and privacy-public routers 95.6% and 97.3% statements; TransferDialog.tsx 94.8% statements, 96.8% lines, 89.9% branches. The package-wide figure is measured by the pre-ship coverage step.

definition_of_done_items.criterion: Portability requests can download the export as CSV (one file per category, zipped) as well as JSON
definition_of_done_items.evidence: Merged in #1365 (apps/web/src/lib/dsar/export-csv.ts, "Save as spreadsheets (CSV)" on /dsar/[handle]/export); also offered on the new /dsar/transfer page.

definition_of_done_items.criterion: Where technically feasible the person can ask for the data to be sent to another controller (Art 20(2))
definition_of_done_items.evidence: An admin approves a transfer on a confirmed portability request (privacy.admin.createTransfer, the "Send to another controller" dialog in /settings/privacy-requests), recording how the person asked. The recipient pulls the export through a single-use link. this pull request.

definition_of_done_items.criterion: Through an admin-approved transfer with an expiring link
definition_of_done_items.evidence: ADMIN-only, own firm only (another firm gets NOT_FOUND, proven on a real database). Link valid for 7 days, expiry enforced on the server.
dsar_transfer_events holds created, sent, downloaded, expired and revoked steps with who and when, shown in the admin dialog, plus audit log rows.

notes: Two halves: the CSV export (#1365) and the Art 20(2) transfer (this pull request). Migration 20261128100000_dsar_transfers is Class A and additive (two new tables). Not verified in a real browser at phone width: the admin dialog and the public page were tested with jsdom and axe only. /dsar/transfer is a dynamic route like every other (public) page, because the shared (public) layout reads the auth cookie; the page itself does no server work.
